What we do

Services

Tap a service to see the details. Every piece starts with a conversation, bring your idea and we will shape it together.

Custom tattoo work by Shawn, tattooing since 2005. His published specialties are realism and neo-traditional, portraits, nature pieces, and bold color work designed for the person wearing it.

Booking runs by email or Facebook message. Send your idea, placement, and rough size and the shop will take it from there.

Piercing in-house by Stephanie of Hocus Poke Us Piercing Studio, working right here at Spiraling Upward.

Her booking line, in her own posts: text (814) 420-4222 to schedule your piercing appointment.

The in-house brow brand at Spiraling Upward: microblading, powder brows, and combo brows.

Consultations are free, reach out through the shop to book one.

Spiraling Upward is a working art gallery as well as a tattoo studio, original artwork and designs from the shop, on the walls at 218 W High St.

The rose and mandala piece shown here is an original design artwork from the studio.
